body: - **Step 0**: `scripts/parse-bootstrap-routing-envelope.sh` `_inv_apply_routing_line_if_empty` case arms (`KEY) [ -z "${KEY:-}" ] && KEY="$_inv_value" ;;`, lines ~86-105) return status 1 when the key is already populated by the file-first parse; under the canonical SKILL.md Step 0 fence (which sources the script with `set -e` active after the rc checks) the first stdout-fallback line (`IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=`) makes the sourced function return nonzero and kills the orchestrator Bash block with exit 1 even though `implement-bootstrap-invoke.sh` succeeded and `bootstrap-routing.env` is complete. Reproduced minimally: `set -e; _inv_out="IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<tmpdir>"; . scripts/parse-bootstrap-routing-envelope.sh` exits 1 before control returns. Same code at repo HEAD (`scripts/parse-bootstrap-routing-envelope.sh:87`). Orchestrator recovered by parsing `bootstrap-routing.env` directly. → dual-written to OOS_1 (out of plan scope for this /design-ratchet PR)
